source_positive_coverage_union.basis: Seven accepted V03 rounds plus independently accepted fresh C1 and R2. The earlier interrupted C remains an additional physical history row. Separate negative-control rounds are outside this positive accounting.

limits_and_measurements.clock_contract: The owner operation starts before installation. Both ordinary children inherit that same monotonic start, deadline and UTC anchor. Native time accumulates across declared spans in both children; provider spans are excluded. The second process does not renew either clock. The per-response bound comes from the unchanged normal-session policy.
limits_and_measurements.intersecting_bounds: Nine responses at their full 600-second ceiling would consume 5400 seconds, leaving at most 2400 other seconds under the total 7800-second ceiling. The native and total ceilings intersect; a caller is not entitled to the sum of all maxima. Any earlier refusal or exhausted boundary stops without retry.

V03_source_observations.interval_definition: Cold command durations run from the preceding completed task-setup event to the completed run event. D baseline intervals run from DYNAMIC_INFORMATIONAL_BASELINE_START to DYNAMIC_INFORMATIONAL_BASELINE_READY.
V03_source_observations.double_counting_rule: The roughly 336-second A and 440-second B command totals already include their D baseline intervals. The roughly 124-second A baseline must not be added again.
V03_source_observations.baseline_semantics: The accepted automatic prepare_source_continuation path remains unchanged. It constructs and validates a genuine D baseline after a cold result; this is preparation, not E and not a substitute for selective delta.
V03_source_observations.no_duration_promise: These measured historical and source-fixture costs support retaining bounded headroom. They do not predict future model latency or guarantee completion before a ceiling. No in-flight timeout or application TTL was extended.

completed_SOURCE_coverage_cost_estimate.exclusions: The original interrupted C wait and its cleanup are excluded from this completed-coverage estimate. completed_SOURCE_coverage_cost_estimate.interpretation: This is a conservative comparison against these measured SOURCE segments, not a proven upper bound for a future run. Inert fixture timing differs from actual model latency and output-dependent validation cost. All ceilings intersect, and source measurements cannot guarantee future duration or successful semantic completion.

declared_native_coverage_comparison.method: Prefix native time is derived from the raw declared ordinary_scenario span through event124, subtracting the 16 fully closed PROVIDER-labelled intervals under the unchanged timer contract. declared_native_coverage_comparison.limit: The summed measurement belongs to two accepted SOURCE segments. It is not one full-route native counter and does not predict future content-dependent native cost.
